```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE,
  dev = "png", dpi = 150
)

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(sf)

# Age buckets, in order. "Total" is the export's all-ages column and is held out
# of the stratified series.
AGE_LEVELS <- c(
  "<5 Years", "5-17 Years", "18-24 Years",
  "25-44 Years", "45-64 Years", "65+ Years"
)

# Fixed categorical order (Okabe-Ito), assigned by age group and never cycled
AGE_COLORS <- setNames(
  c("#0072B2", "#56B4E9", "#009E73", "#E69F00", "#D55E00", "#CC79A7"),
  AGE_LEVELS
)

theme_hepc <- theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey92", linewidth = 0.3),
    axis.title = element_text(color = "grey30"),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
    legend.title = element_text(color = "grey30")
  )
```

```{r data}
hepc_all <- vroom::vroom("standard/data.csv.gz", show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(year = as.integer(substr(time, 1, 4)))

# Keep whole years only; the export's trailing partial period (2026-07-22) is
# not comparable to a full year
hepc <- hepc_all %>% filter(grepl("-12-31$", time))

# Restrict to years present in BOTH source crosstabs. The diagnosis crosstab
# has no age "Total" history for 2018-2019 (predecessor session lacked that
# column), and the two crosstabs' trailing partial periods don't align
# (2026-06-30 medication vs. 2026-07-28 diagnosis) -- see ingest.R. Deriving
# by_age/all_ages/year_breaks from this filtered set keeps every chart below
# comparing the same years.
years_both <- hepc %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(epic_n_patients_hepc), !is.na(epic_n_patients_hepc_medication_pop)
  ) %>%
  distinct(year) %>%
  pull(year) %>%
  sort()

hepc <- hepc %>% filter(year %in% years_both)

stopifnot(all(hepc$age %in% c(AGE_LEVELS, "Total")))

by_age <- hepc %>%
  filter(age != "Total") %>%
  mutate(age = factor(age, levels = AGE_LEVELS))

all_ages <- hepc %>% filter(age == "Total")

year_breaks <- sort(unique(hepc$year))
```

## National trend by age

Limited to `r min(years_both)`-`r max(years_both)`, the years present in both the
diagnosis and medication crosstabs.

```{r ts-national-count}
national <- by_age %>% filter(geography == "00")

ggplot(national, aes(year, epic_n_patients_hepc, color = age)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  scale_color_manual(values = AGE_COLORS, name = "Age group") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = year_breaks) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma) +
  labs(
    title = "Patients with a hepatitis C diagnosis, United States",
    x = NULL, y = "Patients"
  ) +
  theme_hepc
```

```{r ts-national-pct}
ggplot(national, aes(year, epic_pct_hepc, color = age)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  scale_color_manual(values = AGE_COLORS, name = "Age group") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = year_breaks) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = function(x) paste0(x, "%")) +
  labs(
    title = "Share of patients with a hepatitis C diagnosis, United States",
    x = NULL, y = "Percent of patients"
  ) +
  theme_hepc
```

```{r ts-national-treatment}
ggplot(national, aes(year, epic_pct_hepc_medication, color = age)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  scale_color_manual(values = AGE_COLORS, name = "Age group") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = year_breaks) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = function(x) paste0(x, "%")) +
  labs(
    title = "Hepatitis C patients receiving HCV medication, United States",
    x = NULL, y = "Percent receiving treatment"
  ) +
  theme_hepc
```

```{r ts-table}
national %>%
  select(year, age, epic_n_patients_hepc, epic_pct_hepc) %>%
  arrange(year, age) %>%
  mutate(
    epic_n_patients_hepc = scales::comma(epic_n_patients_hepc),
    epic_pct_hepc = sprintf("%.3f%%", epic_pct_hepc)
  ) %>%
  knitr::kable(
    col.names = c("Year", "Age group", "Patients", "Percent of patients"),
    align = "llrr"
  )
```

## State maps by year, all ages

Limited to `r min(years_both)`-`r max(years_both)`, the years present in both the
diagnosis and medication crosstabs.

```{r state-names, include = FALSE}
state_names <- vroom::vroom(
  "../../resources/all_fips.csv.gz", show_col_types = FALSE
) %>%
  filter(nchar(geography) == 2) %>%
  select(geography, geography_name)

# Census state population, single vintage (no year column), so it serves as a
# fixed denominator across all years
state_pop <- vroom::vroom(
  "../../resources/pop_state.csv.gz", show_col_types = FALSE
) %>%
  filter(age_level == "Total") %>%
  inner_join(state_names, by = c("geography" = "geography_name")) %>%
  select(geography = geography.y, popsize)
```

```{r map-setup, include = FALSE}
state_year <- all_ages %>%
  filter(geography != "00") %>%
  left_join(state_pop, by = "geography") %>%
  mutate(rate_per_100k = epic_n_patients_hepc / popsize * 1e5) %>%
  select(
    geography, year, rate_per_100k, epic_pct_hepc, epic_pct_hepc_medication
  )

stopifnot(!any(is.na(state_year$rate_per_100k)))

# Puerto Rico ships with the usmap outlines but the source drops territories
map_base <- usmap::us_map(regions = "states") %>% filter(fips != "72")

# One panel per year with every state present, so no facet is left incomplete
map_sf <- tidyr::expand_grid(fips = map_base$fips, year = year_breaks) %>%
  left_join(state_year, by = c("fips" = "geography", "year")) %>%
  left_join(map_base, by = "fips") %>%
  st_as_sf()

theme_map <- theme_void(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13, hjust = 0),
    strip.text = element_text(
      size = 11, face = "bold", color = "grey20", margin = margin(b = 4)
    ),
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.title = element_text(color = "grey30"),
    panel.spacing = unit(0.4, "lines")
  )
```

```{r map-rate, fig.height = 5.2}
ggplot(map_sf) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = rate_per_100k), color = "white", linewidth = 0.18) +
  facet_wrap(~year, ncol = 3) +
  scale_fill_gradient(
    low = "#DEEBF7", high = "#08306B",
    labels = scales::comma, name = "Per 100,000", na.value = "grey90"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Hepatitis C patients per 100,000 state population, all ages"
  ) +
  theme_map
```

```{r map-pct, fig.height = 5.2}
ggplot(map_sf) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = epic_pct_hepc), color = "white", linewidth = 0.18) +
  facet_wrap(~year, ncol = 3) +
  scale_fill_gradient(
    low = "#FEE6CE", high = "#7F2704",
    labels = function(x) paste0(x, "%"), name = "Percent",
    na.value = "grey90"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Share of Epic patients with a hepatitis C diagnosis, all ages"
  ) +
  theme_map
```

```{r map-treatment, fig.height = 5.2}
ggplot(map_sf) +
  geom_sf(
    aes(fill = epic_pct_hepc_medication), color = "white", linewidth = 0.18
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~year, ncol = 3) +
  scale_fill_gradient(
    low = "#E5F5E0", high = "#00441B",
    labels = function(x) paste0(x, "%"), name = "Percent",
    na.value = "grey90"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Share of hepatitis C patients receiving HCV medication, all ages"
  ) +
  theme_map
```

```{r map-table}
state_year %>%
  left_join(state_names, by = "geography") %>%
  mutate(
    cell = sprintf(
      "%.0f / %.3f%% / %.3f%%",
      rate_per_100k, epic_pct_hepc, epic_pct_hepc_medication
    )
  ) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    id_cols = geography_name, names_from = year, values_from = cell
  ) %>%
  arrange(geography_name) %>%
  rename(State = geography_name) %>%
  knitr::kable(
    align = "l",
    caption = "Cells: rate per 100,000 / % diagnosed / % receiving treatment"
  )
```

## Suppressed state / age / year cells

```{r suppressed-table}
suppressed <- hepc_all %>%
  filter(
    geography != "00",
    epic_n_patients_hepc_suppressed_flag == 1L |
      epic_n_patients_suppressed_flag == 1L
  ) %>%
  left_join(state_names, by = "geography") %>%
  mutate(
    period = if_else(
      grepl("-12-31$", time), as.character(year), paste0(year, " (partial)")
    ),
    age = factor(age, levels = c(AGE_LEVELS, "Total"))
  )

# Collapse to one row per state: the age groups it has suppressed cells in,
# each followed by the years suppressed in that age group
suppressed %>%
  arrange(geography_name, age, time) %>%
  group_by(geography_name, age) %>%
  summarize(years = paste(period, collapse = ", "), .groups = "drop_last") %>%
  summarize(
    combos = paste0(age, ": ", years, collapse = "; "),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(geography_name) %>%
  select(State = geography_name, `Suppressed age × year` = combos) %>%
  knitr::kable(align = "ll")
```
